title: Publish the deployed Shriram Chess Assistant build

requirements.text: Publish the current Shriram Chess Assistant build by running a clean build and deployment so the app is accessible via its public canister URL, and verify that in-app sharing uses the deployed URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean build completes without errors for both frontend and backend.
The deployed app is accessible via its public canister URL after publish.

In the deployed app, the Header Share menu actions work: (1) “Share on WhatsApp” opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message that includes the deployed app URL, and (2) “Copy Link” copies the deployed app URL and shows a success toast.
All user-facing text remains in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if state migration is required.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
No third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is supported.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or new pages beyond publishing the current build.
Changing the chess rules assistant behavior/content beyond what already exists.
Introducing any external database or third-party backend services.
